name: hud_ui_timer_panel_constructor_default
description: HudUiTimerPanel::ConstructorDefault initializes the timer text panel, installs the timer ftable, seeds 00:00:00 time state, makes it visible, and links it into the HUD manager.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this HUD timer constructor; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD panel constructor source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation and assembly for 0x40ed80 validate HudUiPanel construction, g_HudUiPanelSimple_FTable setup, green text colors, Arial font and shadow state, g_HudUiTimerPanel_FTable installation, secondsStep/stopped/elapsedSeconds initialization, SetTimeSeconds(0,0,0), SetVisible(1), and HudUiMgr child linkage.
The native timer/counter constructor smoke verifies the timer ftable, formatted 00:00:00 text, elapsed/stopped/secondsStep fields, and insertion into g_HudUiMgr before the counter panel.
